.Synopsis for the far Southern CA coast...
At 1 PM, a 1025 mb high was 600 miles west of San Diego, and a 
1010 mb low was over western New Mexico. Onshore flow will
continue to weaken this afternoon and evening. Weak offshore flow
in the mornings will alternate with onshore flow in the 
afternoons and evenings tonight through Monday.
